value.title: That`s Why It Needed God
value.synopsis: Twelve years have passed since the battle between Kyo and Goro, and Goro has disappeared from the world and also from people's memories. The series of events is now called the "828 Incident". One day, Eko, who was researching the incident as part of her free research, goes to the site of the 828 Incident, which is still sealed off, in search of the "God she saw in her dream", On the way home, she suddenly sees a notice that says something about God...

value.title: Finally, My Purpose in Life
value.synopsis: Lall remembers Goro, but he appears to have been erased from nearly everyone else's memories. Ryo suggests to Eko that she befriend Lall and help her navigate the upcoming KamiErabi battles, an idea to which Eko reluctantly agrees.

value.title: Unless You Put Your Sorrow Behind You, Happiness Is Just an Illusion.
value.synopsis: Lall's next KamiErabi match is against Honoka, but Honoka has apparently had a change of heart during the past twelve years. She might not even be willing to fight unless she's offered a compelling reason.

value.title: You`re the Last Person I Want to Let Become God
value.synopsis: Lall is on a mission to resurrect Goro so he can win the KamiErabi and become God. She and Eko seek out Iyo, hoping her powers might prove useful. But Iyo has a lot going on in her own life at the moment, so will she be able to help?

value.title: The World Was Already Messed Up
value.synopsis: Akitsu used his powers to undo the carnage inflicted by the mysterious Death Spreader, but all that did was literally buy everyone some time. Ryo once again invites Lall and Eko to work with Gozekai toward uncovering the mysteries behind the KamiErabi.

value.title: So Don`t Cry, It`ll Be Okay
value.synopsis: Chika has been comatose ever since the 828 Incident twelve years ago, and her friend Ryo has faithfully taken care of her all that time. But with the Death Spreader on the move again, will it be too late even if she does wake up?

value.title: If You Want to Save the World, Just Tap That Smartphone
value.synopsis: The Death Spreader seems hopelessly unbeatable, so the God candidates use a combined attack to seal him away in one of Ryo's parallel worlds. Within it, he shows Lall and Kyo his memories of how KamiErabi first came to be--including who created it.

value.title: I Thought Up My Own Lines
value.synopsis: Higaki reveals to Lall and Kyo some game-changer secrets about the KamiErabi and the very nature of the world. A race against time then begins as both the parallel world they're inside and the world from which they came begin to collapse.

value.title: I Mean, of Course, It`s... Me
value.synopsis: After a narrow escape from the parallel world, the remaining God candidates make their way to the facility housing the KamiErabi AI. But then an unexpected guest appears, and she literally flips the script on everyone.

value.title: Everything Turned Out Like This Because You Wanted It To
value.synopsis: Eko reveals her true identity to everyone, and proceeds to threaten humanity's very existence. But Akitsu seems skeptical of her genocidal intent, and he and Lall cook up an impromptu plan to fight back with the only weapon they have left.

value.title: Even If It Means Ruining This Story
value.synopsis: Goro has returned, but he doesn't seem to understand who Eko is or grasp the weighty situation he's now in. Will some advice and assistance from his long-suffering friends lead him to do what needs to be done?

value.title: The Next World You Write Will Be
value.synopsis: Goro goes on a quest to find the final missing piece of his puzzle: his original wish. Once that's been reconciled, the only thing left for the last God candidate to do is have a final showdown with God themself.
